title: Christmas in Berlin - FAQ
subtitle: Opening hours for 24 to 27 December 2026, checked on 25 October 2026.

items.q: Are shops open in Berlin on Christmas Eve?
items.a: Until **14:00**. Berlin law makes every shop close at 14:00 on 24 December when it falls on a weekday. In 2026 that is a Thursday, and because the 25th and 26th are public holidays and the 27th is a Sunday, normal shops stay shut until **Monday 28 December**.

items.q: Which Christmas markets in Berlin are open on 24 December?
items.a: In the centre, the **WeihnachtsZauber on Gendarmenmarkt**, from 11:00 to 18:00 with 2 euros entry. The markets at the **Rotes Rathaus**, the **Humboldt Forum** and **Schloss Charlottenburg** are closed on the 24th and open again on the 25th.

items.q: Are Berlin museums open on Christmas Day and Boxing Day?
items.a: Yes. All museums of the **Staatliche Museen zu Berlin** are closed on 24 December and open on **25 and 26 December as on a Sunday**, 10:00 to 18:00 on Museum Island. The **DDR Museum** opens 9:00 to 21:00 and the **Jewish Museum** 10:00 to 18:00. The Pergamonmuseum stays closed for building works.

items.q: Can I visit the Reichstag dome over Christmas?
items.a: Not on 24 December, when the dome and roof terrace are closed all day. On the **25th, 26th and 27th** it is open from 8:00 to midnight, last entry 21:45, with a free booked slot.

items.q: Where can I buy food in Berlin on 25 and 26 December?
items.a: In the **station supermarkets**. In 2025 the Rewe in **Hauptbahnhof** opened 08:00 to 22:00 and the Rewe in **Ostbahnhof** 06:00 to 22:00 on both holidays; the 2026 hours are not published yet. Petrol station shops also sell the basics.

items.q: Do buses and trains run in Berlin at Christmas?
items.a: Yes. In 2025 the BVG ran a **Saturday timetable on 24 December** and **Sunday timetables on the 25th and 26th**, and every U-Bahn line except the U4 ran all night from 23/24 to 27/28 December. The 2026 holiday timetable is usually published in December.
